items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Johnny Harmon was at the John Hotel when I was there. He was in the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Wiggs went there and recorded him. Really on his death.

Johnny Harmon was at the John Hotel when I was there. He was in the band. You been a player? I wouldn't say so. He was, I don't know. Johnny was more of an authority than I think he was a player. I really don't, I really, I was never impressed by his playing. And that's not nice for me to say. Because he's built up quite a reputation as a teacher. Maybe I'm wrong. I don't know. We had him and Charlie Wagner. Both of them, both of them characters, believe me. I mean, their, habits were entirely different than a…

items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Did he play with Johnny Wiggs, Johnny Honigman? No, uh-uh.

ctx.x: That's where we got our education in piano playing. Really? And faking. There was three piano players down there. Piano player never stopped. So they had to hire extra piano players. Okay. And there was Frank Bonero. I got that name on the tip of my tongue. He was, he was sort of a Spanish, he was a great arranger for Spanish music.
Was he, uh, Noem was well enough. Did he play with Johnny Wiggs, Johnny Honigman? No, uh-uh.
